video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners how ORDER BY sorts the answer of a SQL query, using a table of sales deals

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained, then back out to show everything

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of a table or card draws itself, then the card fills in

table_rows_wipe.what: Each row of a table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

chip_wipe.what: A small label chip is revealed from left to right

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

row_chip_enter.what: A white chip with a violet outline fades in around a row of the stored table

row_copy_travel.what: A copy of a row travels from the stored table across to the result table

row_chip_exit.what: The chip around the travelling row fades away as it lands

rows_reorder.what: The rows of the result table slide up and down past each other into a new order
rows_reorder.scene: no order, default, A to Z, DESC, ties, second column

sort_header_light.what: The header of the column being sorted turns from pale to violet

sort_arrow_draw.what: A violet arrow draws itself along the right side of the result table, pointing the way the values grow

sort_arrow_exit.what: The arrow beside the result table fades away

order_line_out.what: The ORDER BY line in the query slides up and fades out
order_line_out.scene: A to Z, DESC, second column

order_line_in.what: A new ORDER BY line slides up into its place
order_line_in.scene: A to Z, DESC, second column

tie_bands_enter.what: Lavender bands fade in behind the two rows that have the same amount

tie_bands_exit.what: The lavender bands behind the tied rows fade away

tie_check_draw.what: A violet check mark fades in beside the two tied rows once they settle

source_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the whole stored table

source_ring_exit.what: The outline around the stored table fades away

top_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the top two rows of the result table
